description: Z-156T is a Portland cement-based, factory-mixed material requiring only the addition of water on the job for application. It is spray applied, providing up to 4 hours of fire resistance.
whereToUse: exterior environments where a highly durable fireproofing is required and a threat of steel corrosion is present

standards.standard: Up to 4 hours in accordance with the Rijkswaterstaat (RWS) fire curve
Up to 4 hours in accordance with UL 1709 hydrocarbon test
Jet fire testing in accordance with HSE standard OTI 95 634
Up to 4 hours in accordance with UL263 (ASTM E119)
Investigated by UL for exterior use

mixing: a mixer density of 65 to 70 pcf (1040 to 1120 kg/m3)
storage: The material should be kept dry until ready for use.
